briefings.title: "My connection to privacy, and the lack of it, begins from birth": Prince Harry's Full Speech
briefings.tldr: Prince Harry calls for a systemic shift in the tech industry, moving away from extractive business models that prioritize profit over privacy and toward a "Safety by Design" framework that protects users—especially children—as we enter the era of Artificial Intelligence.

briefings.title: Prince Harry Showing Confidence on Stage in Washington, D.C.
briefings.tldr: Prince Harry calls for a fundamental shift from "privacy by extraction" to "privacy by design," arguing that systemic accountability and human-centered regulation are essential to protect society—particularly children—from the harms of social media and emerging artificial intelligence.
